text:
leah: Quick sync: partner asks for a single-page "staging handoff" for Snowflake + Databricks + Qdrant connector bundle. Needs: who owns spares, telemetry line, and a one-paragraph customer-facing ops summary.

omar: Proposed split: Redwood handles hot spares in hubs (SFO, FRA, SIN) for the pilot. Partner retains cold spares. We advertise 24h on-site swap US/EU, 48h APAC. If partner wants guaranteed 24h APAC they must pre-stage or pay express shipping.

nilesh: Eng note: include supported runtime images and quant profiles in the metadata. Also show fallback behavior: if KV cache pressure > 80% we fallback to smaller batch sizes, not model downgrade. Add ops flag to disable auto-fallback for private infra.

cara: Marketplace copy needs a one-liner and 3 bullets: what's included, deployment modes, telemetry. Draft one-liner: "Connector bundle for Snowflake, Databricks, and live vector DBs (Qdrant) with staged hardware options." Legal asked to avoid SLAs for private infra.

legal-bot: Reminder: Public listing can state swap targets and shipping options but must include a caveat: "Final custody and uptime responsibility for customer-managed deployments remains with the customer." Also require partner signing of staging custody addendum.

omar: Runbook snippet for field ops (short):
- verify /health
- run ingest-smoke 500
- if >5% fail -> collect logs /var/log/connector.log && escalate to oncall

infra-bot: preflight | connector-bundle -> 6/7 checks OK. Databricks adapter smoke failing in CI. See CI#4821 and tag @nilesh.

leah: Action list: 1) @legal-bot produce custody blurb + addendum template by Tue 2) @omar confirm hub spare counts and express rates by Tue noon 3) @nilesh add runtime image list + ops-flag into partner runbook 4) @cara draft marketplace bullets & one-liner and share for sign-off by Wed. Check-in Wed 9am PT.

cara: I'll mock the public copy and icons (staged hardware / partner-hosted / private) and post in #design for feedback.

nilesh: I'll triage CI and then update runbook by EOD.

leah: thanks — small dry-run after first staging sounds good. :thumbsup:
